question: Greetings, Oda-sensei. I'm always enjoying your manga. Cutting to the chase, I have a question about the "monsters" in Vol. 32, Chapter 299. At the highest peak of the Harz Mountain ranges in Germany, located on the Mt. Brocken there's a phenomenon termed the Brocken Effect. Was this what inspired your idea? Sorry if I'm wrong... In any case, please take good care and work hard! <3
answer: Yes, actually. It's also known as the Brocken Spectre. It's caused by the same reason you see in my story, so it can also happen in Japan. Also, around the head of the shadow you can see a beautiful ring of rainbow light, which is known as a "goraigou", or "glory" in English. I'd like to see one with my own eyes, once. It must be cool.
name: Akiu
